name: OSINT — Sanctions & Procurement Exposure
description: Entity-resolution-first screening and public-contract analysis that distinguishes listing status, ownership links, political exposure, and mere name similarity.

tasks.name: Resolve subjects
tasks.objective: Normalize organizations/people/assets using legal names, aliases, transliterations, dates, jurisdictions, registration numbers, identifiers, ownership, and other distinguishing facts. Define the exact period and type of exposure being investigated.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Subjects are not screened by ambiguous names alone when stronger identifiers exist.

tasks.name: Screen authoritative lists
tasks.objective: Search current and historically relevant government/official sanctions lists, debarment lists, regulatory notices, and provenance-rich aggregators. Record program, listing basis, effective dates, source dataset, and delisting/changes where applicable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A match identifies the exact listed entity and legal/program context, not merely a similarity score.

tasks.name: Trace ownership and related entities
tasks.objective: Map documented ownership/control, subsidiaries, directors, vessels/securities/assets, and sanctioned or politically exposed related entities using dated corporate and sanctions data. Keep direct designation distinct from ownership/control exposure and from looser association.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every indirect exposure path is an explicit graph path with provenance.

tasks.name: Map public procurement and awards
tasks.objective: Collect relevant tenders, awards, contract amendments, buyer/supplier identities, amounts/currencies, dates, beneficial owners where public, subcontractors, and related entities. Normalize identifiers before comparing vendors across systems.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Contract records preserve buyer, supplier, amount, date, and source identifiers.

tasks.name: Correlate timing and exposure
tasks.objective: Compare award/payment/ownership dates against designation, debarment, office-holding, ownership changes, and regulatory events. Do not apply a current relationship retroactively without evidence it existed at the relevant time.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Risk statements use the relationship and listing status applicable at the event date.

tasks.name: Audit false positives
tasks.objective: Challenge matches for same-name people, transliteration collisions, stale merged entities, corporate renaming, dissolved entities, reused identifiers, unrelated family names, and aggregator topic labels that do not equal legal sanctions status.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Potential false matches are either resolved with identifiers or left explicitly unresolved.

tasks.name: Report documented exposure
tasks.objective: Deliver a dated entity/contract graph and concise report separating direct designation, indirect ownership/control link, PEP or other risk classification, public-contract relationship, and analyst inference. Include source provenance and legal-context caveats; make no legal conclusion beyond the records.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The report distinguishes database risk tags from formal legal status and documents all material matches.
